crew.overview: Seventeen-year-old Stella spends most of her time in the hospital as a cystic fibrosis patient. Her life is full of routines, boundaries and self-control — all of which get put to the test when she meets Will, an impossibly charming teen who has the same illness. There's an instant flirtation, though restrictions dictate that they must maintain a safe distance between them. As their connection intensifies, so does the temptation to throw the rules out the window and embrace that attraction.
crew.title: Five Feet Apart

crew.overview: A couple's relationship is tested when uninvited guests arrive at their home, disrupting their tranquil existence.
crew.title: mother!

crew.overview: Alone on a tiny deserted island, Hank has given up all hope of ever making it home again. But one day everything changes when a dead body washes ashore, and he soon realizes it may be his last opportunity to escape certain death. Armed with his new “friend” and an unusual bag of tricks, the duo go on an epic adventure to bring Hank back to the woman of his dreams.
crew.title: Swiss Army Man

details.biography: Kenzi Parker has been part of the VFX community for nearly ten years with experience on episodic, feature, and commercials. She has worked with clients such as Google, Netflix, and Whatsapp; as well as worked on projects like Hacking Google, In the Heights, and Cowboy Bebop. During her career, she has lived and worked in New York, LA, and Vancouver. She has served on the Board of Managers for VES, spoken at NAB Show, and has mentored students coming from New York's School of Visual Arts
details.name: Kenzi Parker
